kpis.description_fr: Ajouts nets phone postpaid. Leader US depuis 2021. Stratégie Un-Carrier + 5G coverage avantage.
kpis.description_en: Postpaid phone net adds. US leader since 2021. Un-Carrier strategy + 5G coverage advantage.

kpis.description_en: Postpaid phone ARPU. Stable, slight uplift from premium plan mix (Go5G). Lower than VZ but better growth.

kpis.description_en: 5G Home Internet subscribers (FWA). Strong growth cannibalizing cable, ~$50/mo ARPU. 12M MT target.

kpis.description_en: Monthly postpaid churn. Low, stable. Key loyalty indicator vs VZ/T competition.

kpis.description_en: US population covered 5G Ultra Capacity (mid-band/n41). Structural advantage post-Sprint, US mid-band leader.

kpis.description_en: Service revenue (excluding equipment). Key telco operating metric. Strong growth vs flat VZ/T.
